winner_rule.description: Highest S8 mean gain against the stationary null among estimators that remove at least 70% of the archived S4 zero-thinning mean loss; tie-break lower eta RMSE.

steps.step: Step 2 -> Step 3a (stationary null fit of a, n, c, p; profile a, n at true scale)

scope.nz_wc: Wells-Coppersmith rupture scaling is not defined for the sealed New Zealand temporal predictive model; that table is the temporal 1D profile analogue.
scope.s04_nulls: The S04 unit-mark Uniform/Smooth null histories are not part of the reproducible S04B corpus and were not regenerated. The S4 bank, which has zero realized thinning, is the S4 zero-thinning null control.
scope.quadrature: Optimisation uses the frozen tensor-Gauss fast plan. Reported scores use a 20x24-point tensor plan at order 16 (S8/S04B) and the archived adaptive plan for the audit replay. The maximum fast/archived score delta is recorded in independent_audit.json.
